description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Lissandra''' sends a claw of ice in the target direction that deals magic damage to enemies it passes through, decelerating over 1.25 seconds. ''Glacial Path'' can be recast after 0.5 seconds while the claw is active.
description.text: Active: Lissandra sends a claw of ice in the target direction that deals magic damage to enemies it passes through, decelerating over 1.25 seconds. Glacial Path can be recast after 0.5 seconds while the claw is active.

description2.raw: '''Recast:''' '''Lissandra''' [[File:Flash.png|20px|link=Blink|An icon representing the keyword Blink]] [[:Blink|blinks]] to the claw's current location, ending its trajectory.
description2.text: Recast: Lissandra blinks to the claw's current location, ending its trajectory.

notes.raw: *Both casts count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as [[File:Sheen item.png|20px|link=Named item effect#Spellblade|An icon representing the keyword Spellblade]] [[:Named item effect#Spellblade|Spellblade]] and triggering [[File:Kassadin Force Pulse.png|20xpx|border|link=Kassadin#Force Pulse|An icon for Kassadin's ability Force Pulse]] [[Kassadin#Force Pulse|Force Pulse's]] passive. * '''Lissandra''' can reactivate ''Glacial Path'' for the duration (plus another 0.2-0.3 seconds after the claw 'sinks' into the ground). ** The Claw can also hit enemies near the end point at this time, shortly after the missile has reached its maximum range. * ''Glacial Path'' allows '''Lissandra''' to surpass through every single wall in all maps, so long as the claw is at least halfway through them. * ''Glacial Path'' cannot be recast while [[File:Grounded icon.png|20px|link=Ground|An icon representing the keyword Ground]] [[:Ground|grounded]] or [[File:Root icon.png|20px|link=Root|An icon representing the keyword Root]] [[:Root|rooted]]. * ''Glacial Path's'' endpoint shows through terrain, [[sight|fog of war]] and [[File:Brushmaker.png|20px|link=Brush|An icon representing the keyword Brush]] [[:Brush|brush]] to enemies within 600 range of it.
notes.text:
Both casts count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as Spellblade and triggering Force Pulse's passive.
Lissandra can reactivate Glacial Path for the duration (plus another 0.2-0.3 seconds after the claw 'sinks' into the ground).
* The Claw can also hit enemies near the end point at this time, shortly after the missile has reached its maximum range.
Glacial Path allows Lissandra to surpass through every single wall in all maps, so long as the claw is at least halfway through them.
Glacial Path cannot be recast while grounded or rooted.
Glacial Path's endpoint shows through terrain, fog of war and brush to enemies within 600 range of it.
